The legs currently look too bright, saturated, shiny and outlined compared with the original torso. Replace the glossy highlights and coarse contrasting polygon scales with restrained matte painted shading, fine subtle scales, and softer narrow outlines matching image2. Feet/claws must share the same subdued material as the hands and head, with small controlled highlights. No new body, no new objects, no text. True transparent background.
Quirel: muted earthy ochre/gold like her face and forearms, not glowing yellow/orange. Desaturate the vivid lemon highlights; use restrained tan-gold highlights, brown-ochre shadows, charcoal-brown worn leather boots. Fine, understated scales like her arms.
